title: Cream Half-Zip & Black Wide Trousers
prompt: An original young woman with long, loose brown waves stands full-length against a warm tan backdrop. She wears a cream ribbed half-zip sweater with a blue collared shirt peeking out at the cuffs and neck, a pearl necklace, and black wide-leg trousers. She holds brown leather gloves and a black tote. Her expression is calm. Soft, even studio light. Palette of cream, cornflower blue, and black. Refined and classic, in the style of a fall lookbook.
workingNotes:
- The cream sweater and blue cuffs create the color layering.
- Keep the tan backdrop for a warm studio tone.
